name: manual_52d241
claim: In Windows PowerShell 5.1 a jq expression with embedded double quotes passed to gh --jq or -q loses them and fails with errors such as function not defined. Build such output in PowerShell from --json instead of a jq template, run the call from Git Bash, or put the jq program in a file; and treat a nonzero exit from a status check as unknown rather than as an answer.

decisions.notes: 2026-11-04: from Windows PowerShell 5.1, gh pr view with a jq expression containing double-quoted strings failed with function not defined because PowerShell strips embedded double quotes when passing arguments to native executables. The same expression worked from Git Bash.
